content: Your eyes adapt to shadow, seeing clearly where others falter.

In near-darkness (light level 7 or below), your vision sharpens without warning — as though your eyes have always known this. Step into the light and it vanishes, sometimes with a flicker at the boundary where neither dark nor bright fully claims you.
After attuning to the Dark element, your eyes become even more attuned to the darkness.
The Night Vision effect is stabilized and no longer flickers in low light.
